title: Runway Signal Compass — KPI Play & Launch Readiness Canvas
content:
TL;DR: Single sheet to drive the last 14 days of activation readiness for Dedicated/Dedicated-Beta customers. Focus: 1) visible, actionable signals (KPI deltas and owners), 2) rapid rollback/fallback knobs, 3) a simple minute-by-minute first-6h guardrail and owner roster. Use this as the source-of-truth for the sprint to launch (sync with CONFLUENCE page above and POPS-871).

Purpose and audience:
- Purpose: Reduce ambiguity in final-stage readiness and make go/no-go calls measurable.
- Audience: Product Ops lead + Eng on-call + SRE lead + Solutions Eng + AE (customer-facing).

How to use this canvas (quick):
1) At -14d run the baseline audit (traffic sim + smoke).
2) At -7d lock SLO thresholds and owners.
3) Daily standup through -1d uses the top-5 signals below; update values and short comment.
4) Launch day: follow minute-by-minute cadence and escalation checklist.

Top-level launch KPIs (signals we watch, threshold, owner):
- API p95 latency (user-facing): current target <= 450ms, warning >= 500ms, critical >= 650ms. Owner: @Liam (ENG-SRE).
- Error rate (5m window, client-visible 5xx): target < 0.5%, warning >= 0.8%, critical >= 1.5%. Owner: @Marisol (SERVE-RUNTIME).
- QPS capacity vs committed (dedicated pool usage): target >= 100% of baseline capacity available, warning < 90%, critical < 75%. Owner: @Ethan (DEDICATED-OPS).
- Token cost per 1k (running burn estimate): target < $2.40 / 1k tokens, warning >= $2.65, critical >= $3.10. Owner: Finance liaison (TBD).
- Prompt regression rate (eval set): accepted <= 1.5% poor responses, warning >= 2.5%, critical >= 5.0%. Owner: Applied ML / QA.

Signals collection (where values come from):
- Latency/Errors: Redwood Console per-route dashboard + SRE tracing (trace-id sample 1/100).
- Capacity: Dedicated pool telemetry (autoscale events + queue depth).
- Cost: Billing preview sheet (hourly burn estimate).
- Quality: nightly eval runner (eval suite id: EV-quick-14).

Daily readiness checklist (-14d to -1d):
- [ ] Smoke test runbook validated (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/459)
- [ ] Canary data pipeline validated (JIRA: POPS-862)
- [ ] Rollout policy in config (canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%) exists and has auto-fallback set
- [ ] Ops on-call roster published and verified in Slack (channel: #prod-launch)
- [ ] Customer AE notified of fallback behavior + contact list

Pre-launch gating rules (automated + manual):
- Automated green if: p95 < 480ms AND error rate < 0.8% AND capacity util >= 90% AND no regressions in EV-quick-14 in last 24h.
- Manual gate: Product Ops lead + ENG-SRE + SRE manager must sign off if any one metric is in warning range.

Quick contingency and fallback knobs (ranked):
1) Route subset of traffic to lower-cost model-variant (quantized) with identical API. Toggle ID: route-qv.
2) Increase autoscale burst size by +25% for 30m (ticket: POPS-877).
3) Reduce max tokens per request via API throttle (config feature flag).
4) Gradual rollback: canary -> 0% (5-min window) -> 100% rollback if errors continue.

Owner matrix (single-line):
- Product Ops: Aisha (owner), supports: Marisol, Liam.
- ENG-SRE: Liam (latency/error), backup: SRE manager (R. Patel).
- Serving Runtime: Marisol (model runtime), backup: Ethan.
- Dedicated Ops: Ethan (capacity), backup: infra lead (S. Gupta).
- Applied ML / QA: test owner (F. Nguyen).

Launch day rapid cadence (first 6 hours) — minute-by-minute sketch:
- T-0 launch open to customers (minute 0): confirm API responds, smoke quickcases pass (Aisha + Marisol).
- 0-15m: verify p50/p95 and error rate (Liam), check queue depth (Ethan). Update runbook channel with baseline snapshot.
- 15-60m: if any signal in warning, escalate to manual gate; if critical, follow rollback flow.
- 60-180m: metrics cadence every 30m, customer outreach standby.
- 180-360m: reconvene cross-functional triage for trend review, consider staged increase of traffic to full.

Immediate escalation templates (copy into Slack/Email):
- Slack short: "LAUNCH ALERT: [metric] at [value] (threshold [x]). Owner: [name]. Action: [rollback|throttle|route-qv]. JIRA: [ticket]."
- Pager: use SRE on-call rota, escalate to ENG-SRE manager after 10m unresolved.

Open questions / TODO (notes to self):
- Need finance contact for token-burn owner (cc: finance-ops).
- Confirm EV-quick-14 eval dataset mirrors production prompt mix for this customer.
- Add a lightweight synthetic traffic generator in the dedicated pool (small task: POPS-889).
- Decide whether to pre-warm KV caches 2h before go; cost estimate needed.

Post-launch 0–72h telemetry pack (what to capture):
- Hourly p95/p99 latency, 5m error rates, per-route token burn, notable autoscale events, top 10 slowest trace ids, top failed prompt types.
- Post mortem trigger: any critical incident or >24h trending degradation.

Short-run playbook excerpts (copyable):
- Rollback command: /run rollout set --policy canary --pct 0 --force --ticket POPS-877
- Route-qv toggle: /service route set --variant quantized --pct 30 --ttl 30m

Final notes (context and links):
- This doc should be used as the single-runway sheet for the next 14 days pre-launch. Sync daily with CONFLUENCE page (linked_artifacts above) and paste the daily snapshot into Slack #product-ops at EOD.
- Reference customer: AcmeHealth dedicated trial (Customer ID: CUST-1043). Solutions ENG has pre-approved fallback text for customer comms (see GH PR).

Signed-off-by: Aisha (Product Ops).

--END--
